plans.title: Find the plan for your operation
plans.description: Three ways to work with DocumentoIQ based on your processing, collaboration and integration needs.

items.name: DocumentoIQ Starter
items.tagline: Start working with your own processes.
items.description: Teach DocumentoIQ how to work with your documents and create workflows directly from the platform.

items.name: DocumentoIQ Growth

items.name: DocumentoIQ Scale

comparison.title: Compare each plan's capabilities
comparison.description: DocumentoIQ maintains the same foundation. Each plan expands the available capabilities according to your operation's needs.

specializations.title: Your plan defines how you work. Your specialisation defines what DocumentoIQ understands
specializations.description: Plans determine the capabilities available to your operation, while specialisations add document knowledge for the specific needs of each industry.

growth.title: Start where you need to. Move forward when you are ready
growth.description: DocumentoIQ lets you expand capabilities as your processes, team and integration needs change, without switching platforms.

items.title: Starter
items.description: Work with your own processes and documents from the platform.

items.title: Growth
items.description: Add greater capacity and collaboration for teamwork.

items.title: Scale
items.description: Adapt DocumentoIQ to operations that require customisation, integrations and greater support.

growth.closing: Your plan can evolve with you without changing how you work with DocumentoIQ.

items.question: Are Starter, Growth and Scale different products?
items.answer: No. They all use DocumentoIQ. Each plan expands the available capabilities according to your operation's needs.

items.question: Can I change plans later?
items.answer: Yes. You can move to another plan as your processing, collaboration or integration needs change.

items.question: Do specialisations depend on the plan?
items.answer: No. Specialisations provide knowledge for different document contexts; the plan defines the capabilities available for working with DocumentoIQ.

items.question: Which plan do I need for integrations or specific configurations?
items.answer: Scale is designed for operations that require integrations, custom extractions, special output formats and greater support.

cta.microcopy: Not sure which one to choose? We will help you identify the plan that best fits your operation.
